activities.name: Lookup_Watermark
activities.description: Reads the previously successful watermark from ADLS control JSON.

activities.name: Copy_Incremental
activities.source_query_pattern: @concat('SELECT * FROM ', item().source_table, ' WHERE ', item().watermark_column, ' > '''', activity('Lookup_Watermark').output.firstRow.watermark, '''' AND ', item().watermark_column, ' <= NOW()')

activities.name: Copy_Watermark
activities.description: Stores the new watermark in ADLS control/watermark/.
